environment.limits: Inventory only, not an idle-system or thermal measurement. No power/affinity/priority setting changed. Registry ProductName can lag the Windows version. Benchmark peak process memory is recorded separately.

sources.limits: Single sequential series, fixed thread order. No thermal/background-load control. Memory covers entire process, including exports. Auto's effective thread count must be read from child metrics, not inferred.

integration_series.note: Sequential same-build comparisons. GUI uses hidden native HWND/Present(1), not a manual interaction session. Memory includes setup and export.

memory.limits: Whole child process, including startup/export/checkpoint; not solve-only memory. PeakWorkingSetSize is an OS-maintained maximum through the last successful query. Sampled PrivateUsage can miss intermediate peaks. PeakPagefileUsage is reported by name, not equated to RSS/private peak. No child processes are included.

timing.limits: Hidden native window; independent solver controller with configured helper threads, Present(1). Snapshot construction and GUI run concurrently. Not visible GUI or GPU execution timing. Initialization, export and checkpoint are outside wall_seconds. App draw excludes solver work.

timing.limits: Headless worker and polling consumer, not a GUI/rendering benchmark. wall_seconds includes command admission, simulation, publication, consumer application and confirmation latency; initialization and exports are excluded. Delta counts count transmitted entries, including boundary replacements, not unique scientific events. Reported snapshot bytes and retained scalar bytes are not process RSS or allocator capacity. Full exports and checkpoint are requested from the worker after timing.
